description:
Drive and tune vehicles built on hoverboard motor controllers over Bluetooth

Hoverboard Remote drives and tunes vehicles and robots built on hoverboard motor controllers that run the hoverboard-firmware.

The phone connects over Bluetooth LE to an ESP32-C3 bridge wired to the motor controller's SWD header. Through it the app reaches every board of the vehicle.

  • Arm the vehicle and drive it from a throttle pad.
  • Watch speed, battery voltage, phase currents and attitude live.
  • Tune the balance controller's gains while it runs.
  • Sound the horn.
  • Edit each board's settings: pins, IMU, drive mode.

The app needs boards running hoverboard-firmware and a bridge. It does not work with stock hoverboard firmware.
